patterns: APPSC asks current-affairs facts about these bodies: NCSK tenure extension (3 years, Jan 2022), NCW chairperson as of a date (Rekha Sharma, July 2023).
Status trap recurs: NHRC is statutory (PHRA 1993), not constitutional; only NCSC, NCST, NCBC are constitutional.
Other PSCs ask NCW functions = Section 10, PHR Ordinance under Art. 123, NHRC civil-court powers, SHRC selection committee (Governor not a member).
Answers on 'present chairperson' go stale fast; keys must be read by exam date.
App MCQs are sound and closely track these; they add 2026 chairpersons and AP commission details beyond PYQ depth.
